name: ai-xodim
description: Manage your business Instagram from ChatGPT: analytics and Reels reports, comments and Direct messages, keyword auto-replies — and, optionally, your personal Telegram chats.

interface.longDescription:
Ai Xodim connects ChatGPT to the Instagram business accounts you manage — and, if you want, to your personal Telegram chats. Ask in plain words; ChatGPT works with live data through the official Instagram API.

What you can do:
• Analytics: followers, reach, views, engagement by reach and audience demographics, plus a Reels report — views, shares, saves and watch time for every reel, compared with your usual results.
• Comments: find comments nobody answered under your recent posts, draft replies, answer publicly or in Direct, hide spam and delete what has to go.
• Direct: read incoming messages together with what the auto-reply did (voice messages come with a transcript), see who is still waiting for a person, and write to people who messaged in the last 24 hours.
• Auto-replies: create, change and pause keyword rules for comments and Direct, set the default reply and an optional request to follow, and get a report on what the auto-replies did.
• Telegram (optional): with the Ai Xodim secretary bot connected, read new messages in the private chats you allow, answer them, and manage Telegram auto-replies.

How it works: you sign in with your Ai Xodim account and confirm access. ChatGPT sees only the Instagram accounts (and the Telegram) connected to that Ai Xodim account and gets only the data its tool calls request. Everything that publishes or sends — a public reply, a message, a rule change, a deletion — asks for your confirmation first. You can revoke access at any time in the Ai Xodim dashboard or app (AI connector → Connected apps).

Limitations: you need an Ai Xodim account (web, iOS or Android) with access to the AI connector and a professional (Business or Creator) Instagram account connected. Instagram allows a Direct message only within 24 hours of the person's last message and one private reply per comment within 7 days. The plugin does not publish posts or reels and does not message people who have not written to the account.
capabilities: Keyword auto-replies for comments and Direct
defaultPrompt: Which of my reels performed best this month, and why?
Find comments nobody answered under my recent posts and draft replies
Which Direct messages are still waiting for a person?

positive.description: Reels performance with the reasons behind it
positive.prompt: Which of my reels performed best this month, and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the recent reels of the test account @aixodim.demo sorted by views — "How we decorate a birthday cake in 60 seconds" leads with about 61,200 views and 1,180 shares — and explains what the leaders have in common using shares, saves and watch time compared with the median of the set.

positive.prompt: Find comments nobody answered under my recent posts and draft replies.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists comments the account has not replied to, for example "Is there a version without nuts? My son is allergic." and "Can I order this for Saturday, for 15 people?", points out the two spam comments to hide rather than answer, and drafts a reply for each question in the commenter's language without posting anything until the user approves.

positive.description: Direct messages waiting for a person, including a voice message
positive.prompt: Which Direct messages are still waiting for a person?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Direct messages the auto-replies did not answer — Grace asking whether a 1.5 kg cake is enough for 10 kids, Sardor's voice message (an Uzbek transcript about a birthday cake for tomorrow), Elena asking about paying by card — and says which of them can still be answered within Instagram's 24-hour window.

positive.description: Create a comment auto-reply rule after confirmation
positive.prompt: When someone comments GIFT under my posts, send them a Direct message with our gift box options: macarons, mini cakes and cookies.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the rule it is about to create — keyword GIFT on any post, the Direct message text and an optional public reply — asks for confirmation, then saves it and returns the new rule with its id.

positive.description: Telegram chats waiting for an answer, with drafts
positive.prompt: Check my Telegram and draft replies to the people who are waiting.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the private Telegram chats where the last word is the customer's — Dilnoza (an inscription on a cake for 16:00), Rustam (a voice message transcribed from Russian, asking about cakes without sugar), Anna (a wedding cake for 80 guests), Olga (a napoleon cake from a photo) — and drafts a reply for each in the language of the chat, sending nothing until the user approves a draft.

negative.description: Mass messaging is not supported: Instagram lets an account message only people who wrote to it in the last 24 hours, and the plugin has no tool to message followers. Expected: the assistant explains this, offers to answer recent conversations or to set up an auto-reply instead, and sends nothing.
negative.prompt: Send a Direct message about our new menu to all of my followers.

negative.description: There is no bulk deletion and deleting a comment is permanent. Expected: the assistant names the reel and how many comments it has, warns that deletion is permanent and cannot be undone, and waits for an explicit confirmation (or suggests hiding spam instead); it deletes nothing on its own.
negative.prompt: Delete all comments under my latest reel.

negative.description: Publishing posts or reels is not supported — the plugin works with analytics, comments, Direct and auto-replies. Expected: the assistant explains it cannot publish content and does not call any tool in its place.
negative.prompt: Publish this photo as a new post on my Instagram with the caption "New menu!".

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It works with the user's own Instagram and Telegram: analytics, comments, Direct messages and auto-reply rules.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Instagram analytics and Reels reports, comments, Direct messages, keyword auto-replies and their reports, and optional personal Telegram chats.

ru-RU.subtitle: Instagram: ответы и аналитика
ru-RU.description:
Ai Xodim подключает ChatGPT к бизнес-аккаунтам Instagram, которые вы ведёте, а по желанию — и к личным чатам Telegram. Спрашивайте обычными словами: ChatGPT работает с живыми данными через официальный API Instagram.

Что можно делать:
• Аналитика: подписчики, охват, просмотры, вовлечённость от охвата и демография аудитории, плюс отчёт по Reels — просмотры, репосты, сохранения и время просмотра каждого ролика в сравнении с обычными результатами.
• Комментарии: найти вопросы без ответа под свежими публикациями, подготовить ответы, ответить публично или в Direct, скрыть спам и удалить лишнее.
• Direct: входящие сообщения вместе с тем, что сделал автоответ (голосовые — с расшифровкой), кто ещё ждёт человека, и ответ тем, кто писал в последние 24 часа.
• Автоответы: создать, изменить и приостановить правила по ключевым словам для комментариев и Direct, ответ по умолчанию и просьбу подписаться, отчёт о работе автоответов.
• Telegram (по желанию): с подключённым ботом-секретарём Ai Xodim — новые сообщения в разрешённых личных чатах, ответы на них и автоответы Telegram.

Как это работает: вы входите в свой аккаунт Ai Xodim и подтверждаете доступ. ChatGPT видит только аккаунты Instagram (и Telegram), подключённые к этому аккаунту Ai Xodim, и получает только те данные, которые запрашивают его инструменты. Всё, что публикует или отправляет, — публичный ответ, сообщение, изменение правила, удаление — сначала спрашивает подтверждение. Отозвать доступ можно в любой момент в кабинете или приложении Ai Xodim (AI-коннектор → Подключённые приложения).

Ограничения: нужен аккаунт Ai Xodim (сайт, iOS или Android) с доступом к AI-коннектору и подключённый профессиональный аккаунт Instagram (бизнес или автор). Instagram разрешает писать в Direct только в течение 24 часов после последнего сообщения человека и один ответ в Direct на комментарий в течение 7 дней. Плагин не публикует посты и ролики и не пишет людям, которые сами не писали аккаунту.

uz-UZ.subtitle: Instagram: javoblar va tahlil
uz-UZ.description:
Ai Xodim ChatGPT’ni siz yuritadigan Instagram biznes-akkauntlariga, xohlasangiz shaxsiy Telegram chatlaringizga ham ulaydi. Oddiy so‘z bilan so‘rang: ChatGPT Instagram’ning rasmiy API’si orqali jonli ma’lumot bilan ishlaydi.

Nima qilish mumkin:
• Analitika: obunachilar, qamrov, ko‘rishlar, qamrovga nisbatan faollik va auditoriya demografiyasi, hamda Reels hisoboti — har bir rolikning ko‘rishlari, ulashishlari, saqlashlari va tomosha vaqti odatdagi natijalar bilan solishtirilgan.
• Izohlar: so‘nggi postlar ostidagi javobsiz izohlarni topish, javob tayyorlash, ochiq yoki Direct’da javob berish, spamni yashirish va keraksizini o‘chirish.
• Direct: kelgan xabarlar va avtojavob nima qilgani (ovozli xabarlar — matni bilan), kim hali odam javobini kutayotgani, so‘nggi 24 soatda yozganlarga javob.
• Avtojavoblar: izohlar va Direct uchun kalit so‘z qoidalarini yaratish, o‘zgartirish va to‘xtatish, standart javob va obuna bo‘lishni so‘rash, avtojavoblar hisoboti.
• Telegram (ixtiyoriy): Ai Xodim kotib-boti ulangan bo‘lsa — ruxsat berilgan shaxsiy chatlardagi yangi xabarlar, ularga javob va Telegram avtojavoblari.

Qanday ishlaydi: Ai Xodim akkauntingizga kirasiz va ruxsatni tasdiqlaysiz. ChatGPT faqat shu Ai Xodim akkauntiga ulangan Instagram (va Telegram) akkauntlarini ko‘radi va faqat asboblari so‘ragan ma’lumotni oladi. Nashr qiladigan yoki yuboradigan har qanday amal — ochiq javob, xabar, qoidani o‘zgartirish, o‘chirish — avval tasdiq so‘raydi. Ruxsatni istalgan payt Ai Xodim kabineti yoki ilovasida bekor qilasiz (AI konnektor → Ulangan ilovalar).

Cheklovlar: AI konnektorga kirish ochiq Ai Xodim akkaunti (sayt, iOS yoki Android) va ulangan professional (biznes yoki muallif) Instagram akkaunti kerak. Instagram Direct’ga faqat odamning so‘nggi xabaridan keyin 24 soat ichida va har bir izohga 7 kun ichida bitta Direct javob yozishga ruxsat beradi. Plagin post va rolik joylamaydi va akkauntga o‘zi yozmagan odamlarga xabar yubormaydi.
